Build and optionally publish cohort information

Source: R/cohort_info.R
run_cohort_info.Rd

cohort_info is a hospitalization-based association table that contains generic columns (hospitalization sequence, diagnostic ICD summary, composite visit key, and the cohort membership flag cohort_index). When ICU identifiers exist, admission-level values may appear on multiple ICU association rows; source event tables are not duplicated by this function. Domain enrichment is added by classify_fn.

Usage

run_cohort_info(
  con,
  schema_names,
  src_name,
  icd_filter_path = NULL,
  icds_dict_path = NULL,
  icd_adjudication_path = NULL,
  classify_fn = NULL,
  classify_args = list(),
  analysis_level = c("admission", "icu"),
  publish = TRUE
)

Arguments

con

DBI connection.

schema_names

List from src_schema_names() - uses $raw.

src_name

Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo").

icd_filter_path

Deprecated and ignored: membership comes from the cohort definition recorded at import. Accepted so existing calls keep working; a note is printed when it is supplied.

icds_dict_path

Path to ICD description CSV/RDS with icd_code, icd_version, long_title. Optional for MIMIC (long_title columns are then omitted); required for eICU, where it resolves ICD versions.

icd_adjudication_path

Optional reviewed eICU ICD-version crosswalk. Used only for eICU after exact dictionary matching remains ambiguous.

classify_fn

Optional R function for domain-specific enrichment. Called as: do.call(classify_fn, c(list(diag_exp, con, raw_schema, src_name, group_col), classify_args)). Must return a data frame keyed by group_col with enrichment columns to left-join onto cohort_info. Use scid_classify for the SCI reference implementation. Set NULL (default) to write generic columns only.

classify_args

Named list of extra arguments forwarded to classify_fn.

analysis_level

Grain of the composite ehr_id key and of cohort_index: "admission" (default) builds ehr_id from patient + admission ids; "icu" additionally appends the ICU stay id. The table still carries all id columns either way.

publish

Whether to publish cohort_info to the raw schema. Set to FALSE when a caller will publish several clinical tables atomically.

Value

Invisibly returns the cohort_info data frame.

Details

cohort_index is the single public membership flag. It is the cohort definition recorded at import (cohort_hierarchy.definition_filter_index), never the import scope: importing more context (patient rather than hospital import_scope) adds nonmember rows without changing membership. ICD cohorts select hospitalizations containing a matching diagnosis in every source, so each ICU stay of a qualifying hospitalization is a member; SQL, direct-ID, function and Sepsis-3 cohorts keep their selected grain. With analysis_level = "icu" each row carries its own ICU stay's membership; with "admission" every row of an admission carries any() over that admission's rows. Membership of a hospitalization does not establish that the diagnosis was present at the start of any ICU stay.

If cohort_hierarchy is missing - data imported before the cohort hierarchy existed, or a standalone raw schema - a cohort_info row has no hierarchy row, or the cohort is an eICU ICD cohort built with the superseded unit-stay selection, this function stops with an error; re-run the cohort import (import_cohort_general() and run_db()). There is no fallback to ICD matching or to the retired hos_cohort_flg.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- connect_postgres("rendehr", load_credentials("config/config_pass.json"))
run_cohort_info(con, src_schema_names("mimic_iv_demo"), "mimic_iv_demo")
} # }
